verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Zoho Books can 'generate invoices' and 'track payments' (via MCP/Zia docs), implying some invoicing and payment-tracking capability, but there is no explicit documentation of online payment gateway options embedded in invoices or of invoice 'viewed' status tracking. missing for 10: dedicated docs on online payment gateway/checkout options on invoices, evidence of 'viewed' status/read-receipt tracking, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of the payment/view workflow.
